# Ad example library

> Breakdowns of public ads for any LLM or agent. Each file is an original analysis plus the official page link. No video files.

This library is for studying structure. Query it, read a few matches, then build a new ad with the user's own tools.

## Start

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — the only workflow
- [index.json](index.json) — generated catalog
- [schema/ad-breakdown.schema.json](schema/ad-breakdown.schema.json)

## Search

```
node scripts/search.mjs --platform tiktok --niche ai-saas --goal conversion --keyword demo
```

Filters: `--platform`, `--niche`, `--goal`, `--keyword`.

## Platforms

- [TikTok](platforms/tiktok.md)
- [Instagram Reels](platforms/instagram-reels.md)
- [YouTube Shorts](platforms/youtube-shorts.md)
- [YouTube in-stream](platforms/youtube-instream.md)
- [YouTube bumper](platforms/youtube-bumper.md)
- [Meta feed](platforms/meta-feed.md)
- [Meta Stories](platforms/meta-stories.md)
- [X](platforms/x.md)
- [Pinterest](platforms/pinterest.md)

## Rules

- Store the official link and the written breakdown. Do not download, rehost, or scrape the video.
- If an award is not on a public page, `award` is null.
- `rebuild_recipe` must not reproduce the brand's art, logos, characters, or exact lines.
